text_description: Full-length runway look built around a slim, close-to-body silhouette: a sheer dark brown short-sleeve top with a high crew neckline is worn tucked into a high-waisted pencil-style skirt, the transparency revealing the model’s skin tone beneath and giving the upper body a lightweight, second-skin effect. The skirt falls to below the knee/mid-calf with a straight narrow shape and is dominated by an oversized black-and-white photographic portrait print across the entire front panel, showing a face and collared shirt/tie motif scaled from waist to hem; darker side areas frame the print and the lower edge curves slightly with the printed image. A narrow pale gray belt with small metallic holes or studs sits at the waist, emphasizing the separation between the sheer top and graphic skirt. Styling is minimal, with a delicate gold pendant necklace at the chest, long loose center-parted hair, and brown pointed-toe heeled pumps, creating a stark, polished, art-print-focused ready-to-wear look.
key_elements: sheer dark brown fitted short-sleeve crew-neck top
oversized grayscale photographic portrait print on skirt front
narrow pale gray studded or perforated belt
uncertainty_notes: Exact fabric composition is not visible.
Belt hardware details appear metallic but are not fully clear.
